full_track.tags: K-Indie pop with bossa nova influences. A nylon-string acoustic guitar plays syncopated bossa nova chords. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with light chorus and reverb. The bass guitar follows a traditional bossa nova pattern of roots and fifths. Percussion consists of a shaker and a subtle rimshot on the snare. Female vocals are delivered in a soft, breathy, conversational style with minimal vibrato. The arrangement is sparse and intimate. Key of G Major, 100 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
